claims: Karol G is headlining the 2026 Coachella Music Festival.
Karol G is performing on the main stage on Sunday nights (April 12 and 19) at the 2026 Coachella Music Festival.
Karol G is the first Latina to headline the Coachella Music Festival.
Karol G's main set closes out the Sunday night performances at the 2026 Coachella Music Festival.
Karol G is curating a special Flea Market by Bichota Records on Sundays at the 2026 Coachella Music Festival.
The special Flea Market by Bichota Records is to feature Latin brands and entrepreneurs.
Karol G's preparation marks her return to the stage after her Mañana Será Bonito Tour.
The 2026 Coachella Music Festival is streaming free.
The 2026 Coachella Music Festival streaming includes a multiview option.
Karol G's performance at the 2026 Coachella Music Festival can be watched via the official Coachella YouTube channel.
Karol G appeared at Coachella in 2022.
Karol G honored Latin artists with a medley at Coachella in 2022.
Karol G's medley at Coachella in 2022 included Selena.
Karol G's medley at Coachella in 2022 included Ricky Martin
